title: LIVE UPDATES: Impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte
summary: Bookmark this page for Rappler's comprehensive coverage of Vice President Sara Duterte's impeachment trial at the Senate

blocks.text: The impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte — the first Philippine public official to be impeached twice by the House of Representatives — began at 2 pm on Monday, July 6.

There are four articles of impeachment against Duterte involving alleged misuse of confidential funds, unexplained wealth, bribery of Department of Education officials, and grave threats against President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. and his family.

Only 21 out of 24 senator-judges are physically present. Senator Bato dela Rosa remains in hiding as he faces an International Criminal Court arrest warrant over Rodrigo Duterte’s drug war, Senator Jinggoy Estrada has been detained and suspended in connection with a plunder case, and Senator Rodante Marcoleta surrendered to authorities as he also faces a plunder case.
On this page, we bring you the latest updates, analyses, videos, and photos as the trial of the Vice President unfolds.

blocks.text: Nov 20, 2026 5:43 PM PHT
Ridon: ‘We wasted last 2 weeks on non-issues’

House prosecutor Terry Ridon says the last two weeks of the defense’s presentation of evidence were wasted on “non-issues,” adding that Vice President Sara Duterte’s lawyers and witnesses failed to properly answer the senator-judges’ questions on the allegations against her.
Ridon also says he hopes the defense will present Duterte’s husband, Mans Carpio, and Dr. Lourdes Lebosada as witnesses.

blocks.text: Nov 20, 2026 3:53 PM PHT
How many employees does Cale88 really have?
Questions are raised on the actual number of employees hired by Cale88, the firm once owned by Mans Carpio during the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte on Friday, November 20.

The defense’s witness, Trade Undersecretary Ceferino Rodolfo, says the company has 201 employees as of 2024 based on DTI’s records. But the firm’s Securities and Exchange filings show it has no “rank and file” employees and no “manpower complement” in 2024.

blocks.text: Nov 20, 2026 3:52 PM PHT
Aquino to defense witness: ‘Who can explain Cale88 inward remittances?’

Defense witness DTI Undersecretary Ceferino Rodolfo admits he is not knowledgeable about the alleged discrepancy between Cale88’s P208 million in sales and P776 million in inward remittances to the company, as reflected in AMLC records.
He says it is the first time he has encountered such an incident.
Senator-judge Bam Aquino then asks who can explain the figures. Rodolfo replies that the company’s owners and officers, including part-owner Dr. Lourdes Lebosada, could provide an explanation.
